_doc: Every numeric comparison MUST resolve a key here. Missing key = test throws. Changing a tolerance requires approvedBy + approvedOn. This replaces the charter's rtol=1e-6 default ONLY where explicitly recorded. An entry that is not yet approved must be recorded in `pendingApproval` (owner + closingWeek + reason) or `verify:tolerances --strict` fails — this list may only shrink. Every entry below carries a licensed-engineer ruling dated 2026-10-26 (project/decision-log/DEV-007.md). Any future change to a tolerance requires a NEW approver and a new date.
